limitations: Temporary working space is required for one movie at a time.
Unpreservable bitmap tracks or HDR conversions retain the original rather than silently dropping tracks or reducing quality.
Receiver codec/HDR support and end-to-end iPhone/Drive/Roku behavior require a new device retest.
